dict.string: DM Control uses automation for media controls, Digital Light shortcuts, and optional application context.
DM Control uses Accessibility to paste dictation and perform configured keyboard shortcuts.
DM Control records the other participants' audio only while you record a meeting, and keeps it on this Mac.
DM Control reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you before meetings and title their recordings. Nothing leaves your Mac.
